text: Manuleleua Paletasala Tovale is a Samoan politician and former member of the Legislative Assembly of Samoa, affiliated with the FAST Party. He was first elected to the Legislative Assembly in the 2021 Samoan general election. An election petition against him was dismissed in June 2021. On 28 July 2021, he was appointed Associate Minister for the Prime Minister and Cabinet. On 17 January 2025, he was removed from his position as associate minister by Prime Minister Fiamē Naomi Mataʻafa following his support for her expulsion from the FAST Party.
